result.summary: This PR modifies the IWYU CI job's test script so that a clang 'fatal error:' encountered during analysis causes the job to fail, rather than being swallowed by an existing '|| true' and only appearing in raw logs. It adds a grep check after capturing IWYU output, printing the offending file and a pointer to the GOAL header targets in the setup script. This is a follow-up to two already-merged PRs (#35468, #36228) that fixed the root cause of the fatal errors.
result.problem: Previously, if IWYU could not compile a file (e.g. due to a missing generated header), the error was only visible in raw CI logs and never failed the job, letting real problems go unnoticed for a long time (as happened with issue #35361). This PR closes that gap so future regressions of the same kind are caught automatically.

result.card: This PR makes the IWYU CI job fail when IWYU's underlying compiler hits a 'fatal error:', instead of silently logging it via a swallowed '|| true' exit code, as previously happened with issue #35361. It is a small (12-line) follow-up to two already-merged PRs (#35468, #36228) that fixed the root cause (missing generated headers), and its purpose is to guard against future regressions of the same kind, such as a new capnp header or renamed build target. The author confirmed the current master IWYU log has no fatal errors, so this will not turn CI red today. Reviewability is Ready: the change is small, self-contained, and has no CI or rebase issues. Agreement is Strong so far, with a Concept ACK from maintainer hebasto and no objections, though review is still light with only one comment.
